summary: The v41 hostile incubus reaches mhitu.c:doseduce and calls the private mayberem helper for the hero’s worn cloak. In the recorded branch, rn2(20)=14 is not below charisma 10, so C calls SetVoice, verbalizes “Take off your cloak; it’s in the way.”, and removes the cloak with remove_worn_item. JavaScript currently replaces every doseduce mayberem call with note_unported, skipping the RNG, message/pause, and armor state change; the first differing C RNG call is mayberem and screen/cursor output diverges immediately after it. Port the complete void helper and wire all existing doseduce call sites in C source order.

source.branch: doseduce reaches mayberem with a worn armor object while no transport is pending and the monster remains adjacent; mayberem chooses the deaf path, charisma prompt path, or verbalized removal path, then removes the item unless the player declines.

evidence: nethack-c/upstream/src/mhitu.c:2309-2350 defines mayberem as a void helper. It first skips absent/unworn items and refuses after transport or loss of adjacency; then Deaf emits a direct pline, high charisma draws rn2(20) and may ask a y_n question using short-circuited rn2(2) terms, and the other path calls SetVoice and verbalize before remove_worn_item(obj, TRUE).

nethack-c/upstream/src/mhitu.c:doseduce calls mayberem for gloves during ring handling and then for cloak, suit, boots, gloves, shield, helm, and shirt in that exact order. Its void result is ignored; side effects and pauses determine subsequent behavior.

challenges/cases/v41/v41-incubus-mayberem-pager-corrected.session.json, segment 0, zero-based step 40 records rn2(20)=14 at mayberem(mhitu.c:2325); step 42 records the C line “Take off your cloak; it’s in the way.” The session reaches the helper through #wizgenesis hostile incubus and wait actions.
